newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady, seen to move higher.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady, seen to move higher.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes were steady but the market is assessed to move higher on expections that cargo prices would edge firmer, traders said on Tuesday.
Majors were asking $121 per tonne for 180-cst and at $117-$118 for 380-cst. Independents quoted a shade lower at $115 for 380-cst and $120 for 180-cst. Majors said enquiries were thin.
One to two traders remained uncertain of near term market direction, citing a volatile crude market.
MDO prices stayed at $212-$218 and gas oil at $222-$228.
